catalog.title: 1969 Seiko JDM Catalog No.2
catalog.note: JDM catalogue (Seiko Watch Catalog '69 No.2). Each caption prints a family code + model number (e.g. 61GAW 010, 56LMW 25石 017; ladies' models R-/S-/A- numbers, e.g. 10QS 23石 S-403), the jewel count (石) except on Grand/King Seiko and battery watches, the printed features, and list prices in yen per case material (SS・WP, SGP・WP, 14K・WG, WGP, ASGP, PDP, ACRP …); a second number marked 和 is the same watch with a Japanese day wheel. It prints no case-movement (CCCC-NNNN) refs and no bracelet codes. caliber is the movement number where the printed code is the movement itself (2559, 2539, 1944, 2519, 2501, 6159, 6117, 6618) or where Seiko's family code names exactly one movement (61GAW 6146, 61GAC 6145, 45GSC 4522, 45GS 4520, 56KAW 5626, 56KAC 5625, 45KSC 4502, 45KS 4500, 56LMW 5606, 40BW 4006, 40BC 4005, 61SP 6139, LM36 5740, 61-5D 6106, 61-5 6119); other families are left blank. The diver on p.36 is printed as 6159 25石 010/011 with 300 m water resistance; the 150 m diver is printed as 61MC 17石 010 (61 Seikomatic Calendar), not as 6105-8000. Dial colours are read from the photos.
catalog.method: vision extraction in-harness (no paid API): pages rendered, read by Claude subagents writing batch JSON. Oct 2026 re-verification: every pictured watch (435, up from 340 records) was re-tied to its printed caption from the 250 DPI renders, and ref/code, jewels, every printed price, case material, water resistance, features and section were re-read from caption crops and cross-checked against the PDF text layer; the earlier records' invented CCCC-NNNN refs were replaced by the printed model codes.
